default/32282.htm.text: Yiyen: Yikes! That was a surprise. ... I'm sorry. I didn't mean to act so shocked -- it's just so unusual to see people in this area... links.text: Ask about the interior of the Mansion.
Ignore her and enter the Darkcloud Mansion.

default/32282-1.htm.text: Yiyen: Ah, that is... I'm sorry. To tell you the truth, I haven't actually been inside either. Perhaps I should have gone in, but I've been so busy investigating the surroundings, finding a place to stay and writing letters to my father. I've been procrastinating, I know. ... No, no, no -- it's not…

Ignore her and enter the Dark Cloud Mansion.
